comments.body:
Implementation detail for this story (the description carries the decisions).

Pair list for `tests/scripts/`, filtered from enumeration (2) of the test-suite epic's first comment. Format: `base | heldout LOC | RENAME (differing defs)`; the twin is `<base>_heldout.py`. No test-function name collides in these pairs; definitions that collide with DIFFERENT bodies are named in the RENAME column (rename on merge); every other colliding definition is identical (dedupe: keep the base copy; `pytestmark` counts here).

| # | base | heldout LOC | RENAME (differing defs) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `tests/scripts/test_backfill_bug_class.py` | 134 | `_closed_bug` |
| 2 | `tests/scripts/test_backfill_caused_by.py` | 127 | - |
| 3 | `tests/scripts/test_backfill_complexity_clone.py` | 100 | `_repo_with_commits` |
| 4 | `tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge.py` | 545 | `FakeRunner`, `alert_env`, `hb_env`, fixture `mod` |
| 5 | `tests/scripts/test_check_adr_numbers.py` | 185 | `_SCRIPT`, `_adr`, fixture `gate` |
| 6 | `tests/scripts/test_check_config_ownership.py` | 272 | `_root` |
| 7 | `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads.py` | 343 | `_SCRIPT`, `_tree`, fixture `gate` |
| 8 | `tests/scripts/test_migrate_success_criteria.py` | 206 | - |
| 9 | `tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion_port.py` | 188 | `_mod` |
| 10 | `tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py` | 222 | - |

10 pairs; 7 renames = rows 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9. The held-out LOC for rows 5, 6 and 7 are the origin/main 083620b0 sizes; E10a-S3 (aware-obvious-sphinx) deletes from those three twins, before this story, the real-tree and CI-wiring tests named in table (3) of the test-suite epic's first comment (`test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py`: `test_ci_wires_the_gate`, `test_real_repo_tree_is_clean`, `test_real_tree_has_no_duplicate_numbers`, `test_real_tree_marker_per_adr`, `test_real_check_script_runs_as_subprocess`; `test_check_config_ownership_heldout.py`: `test_real_source_tree_is_clean`, `test_main_on_real_tree_returns_zero`; `test_check_config_reads_heldout.py`: `test_real_repo_is_clean_with_default_paths`, `test_real_schema_markers_all_carry_pointers`, `test_string_read_fields_keep_their_marker_and_do_not_fire` (4 params), `test_the_real_schema_parks_no_markers_against_a_ticket`, `test_ci_wires_the_gate`), so this story merges the post-E10a-S3 remainder and takes its before-counts after that story landed.

Rename rule: suffix the HELD-OUT definition `_heldout` (e.g. `_closed_bug_heldout`, `_SCRIPT_HELDOUT` for a module constant, `gate_heldout` for a fixture, `FakeRunner_heldout` for a class) and repoint its callers; keep the base copy of identical definitions.

Merge recipe per pair: `cat` the held-out module into the base under a `# ── held-out oracles (merged from <name>_heldout.py) ──` divider; keep the base module docstring and append the held-out docstring's "what it proves" paragraph (rows 5-7 keep their bug 2c58-e710-275e-4ff7 cite); dedupe identical definitions (incl. `pytestmark`); rename differing definitions with the `_heldout` suffix and repoint callers; `git rm` the held-out file. Record per pair: `pytest --collect-only -q <base> <heldout>` before, `pytest --collect-only -q <base>` after.

Not in this story: `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py` (the only `*_red_proof.py`; untouched), the 8 `tests/scripts/*_seam_clean_heldout.py` modules (deleted by E10a-S1), and the 4 unpaired `tests/scripts/` held-out modules (renamed in S5).

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
10 modules directly under `tests/scripts/` have a `<name>_heldout.py` twin. Once both oracles have been reviewed the split only doubles module count, duplicates identical helper definitions, and makes every rename touch two files. Across these 10 pairs no test-function name collides; 7 pairs carry helper/fixture/class/const definitions with differing bodies (this directory has the densest rename set) and every other colliding definition is identical. Three of the held-out twins — `test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py`, `test_check_config_ownership_heldout.py`, `test_check_config_reads_heldout.py` — lose their real-tree and CI-wiring tests in the test-suite epic's single-owner story (E10a-S3, aware-obvious-sphinx); this story merges the post-E10a-S3 remainder of those three modules. The pair list with per-pair rename sets, filtered from enumeration (2) of the test-suite epic's first comment, is itemised in this ticket's first comment. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
Directory: `tests/scripts/` — 10 pairs, 7 renames (`test_backfill_bug_class`, `test_backfill_complexity_clone`, `test_canary_bridge`, `test_check_adr_numbers`, `test_check_config_ownership`, `test_check_config_reads`, `test_normalize_ci_conclusion_port`). For each pair: `cat` the held-out module into the base under a `# ── held-out oracles (merged from <name>_heldout.py) ──` divider; keep the base module docstring and append the held-out docstring's "what it proves" paragraph; dedupe identical definitions (`pytestmark` counts here — keep the base copy); rename differing definitions and repoint their callers; `git rm` the held-out file. Rename rule: suffix the HELD-OUT definition `_heldout` (e.g. `_load_heldout`, `_SCRIPT_HELDOUT` for a constant, `gate_heldout` for a fixture) and repoint its callers; keep the base copy of identical definitions. `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py` (the only `*_red_proof.py`) is untouched and stays a separate module; `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads.py` and its twin cite bug 2c58-e710-275e-4ff7, and that docstring stays the base docstring. No test body changes.

## Scope
In scope: the 10 base modules under `tests/scripts/` named in the first comment and their 10 `_heldout` twins. Out of scope: `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py`, the 4 unpaired `tests/scripts/` held-out modules (renamed in S5), the pairs of S1, S2 and S3, every `scripts/check_*.py`, the `Makefile`, every file under `src/`, and any test body change.

## Testing
Per pair: `pytest --collect-only -q <base> <heldout>` before and `pytest --collect-only -q <base>` after — counts equal (both recorded on this ticket; the before count for the three `test_check_*` pairs is taken after E10a-S3 landed); `pytest <base>` green. `make test` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero paired twins remain in this directory: for each of the 10 pairs `git ls-files tests/scripts/<base>_heldout.py` prints nothing (the 4 unpaired `_heldout` modules here are untouched and renamed in S5).
- [ ] Per-pair node counts reconcile: each merged base collects exactly the sum of the two prior counts, from the before/after `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` shows `new=0` (no `tests/_*.py` helper, check script, workflow step, nor autouse fixture is added).
- [ ] `make verify` green.
